name: argentina-income-tax
description: Use this Argentine income tax reference whenever asked about Impuesto a las Ganancias for self-employed individuals (autónomos, profesionales independientes) in the general regime. Match phrases like Ganancias, impuesto a las ganancias, autónomo Argentina, monotributo vs responsable inscripto, cuarta categoría, deducciones personales, ganancia no imponible, bienes personales, DDJJ Ganancias, ARCA, AFIP, CUIT, income tax Argentina, anticipos ganancias, or any question about filing or computing income tax for a self-employed client in Argentina. It gives the art. 94 scale (5% to 35%) and the art. 30 amounts ARCA publishes for periods 2025 and 2026, general deductions, anticipos, percepciones as credits, the Bienes Personales interaction and filing in Ganancias Personas Humanas - Portal Integrado. This Tier 2 draft supports source checking and reviewer questions; it does not authorise filing, payment or a tax position.
